about: Factor rows that are loaded but WITHHELD: kept in the database for traceability, never selected (is_active = False), so the activity is reported as "not calculated — factor under review". A row is released by removing its slug from this file once its mapping, density or method is individually resolved and approved, then re-running the seed commands. Do not release a row for any other reason. Review and the reasons for every released or re-mapped row: audit/stage7/.

coal.reason: Generic / Turkish coal and lignite mapped to UK "Coal (industrial)" (25.4 GJ/t). Turkish lignite has roughly half that calorific value (IPCC default 11.9 TJ/Gg), so the UK row can overstate it about twofold. Needs a fuel-specific Turkish value.

district-heating.reason: The DEFRA value is driven by UK-only infrastructure (UK grid electricity or UK heat networks). DEFRA limits its factors to UK operations (methodology 2026, paras 1.4-1.5, 10.1); for a site outside the UK the number can be wrong by a large factor.

diesel-kwh.reason: The slug is "diesel in kWh" but the DEFRA row mapped is gas oil on a gross calorific basis; neither the fuel nor the calorific basis of a diesel kWh figure is established.

biodiesel.reason: DEFRA publishes several biodiesels (ME 0.168 kg/l, HVO 0.036 kg/l). The catalogue item does not say which; the two differ 4.7 times.
